NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author pushed once: the Home Assistant docs commit is gone, and both settings commits were reworded. The code is unchanged.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Docs change is out of this PR (`doc.md` no longer in the files) and moved to #40197, which has the screenshots. |
| ⚠️  | Commit titles are unchanged and the input doesn't show commit bodies, so the rewording rests on the author's word. Worth a quick look at the commit messages. |
| ✅  | The linked issue #23380 has "help wanted". |
| ℹ️  | The PR renames server settings with compat fallbacks. The issue thread says to discuss this in #backend first, and an earlier attempt (#36416) touching the same files was closed as "not on track". There's no sign of such a discussion here. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — gave the feedback, and closed #36416, so is best placed to judge whether this approach to the settings renames is right.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.
